assets.detail: RION, 22: coral-red short hair, expressive amber eyes, cropped red/white/navy armored jacket, dark bodysuit. Compact cyan crystal plasma carbine held with both hands. Fire/recoil with raised elbows and shoulders rocking back; recover arms lower.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game animation sprite sheet. Create a NEW coherent hand-drawn anime chibi animation sheet using the attached character solely as identity/style reference. Exactly SIX full-body drawings arranged in a perfectly regular 3-column by 2-row grid, 1536x1024 landscape canvas; each 512x512 cell contains one pose. Transparent background with genuine alpha if supported; otherwise a perfectly FLAT PURE MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no checkerboard, no gradients, no shadow underneath feet. NO text, NO labels, NO panel borders. Adult woman chibi proportions, same face, hairstyle, costume, and SAME alien-tech weapon in all frames. Three-quarter view, aiming diagonally toward upper-right, face visible. Camera, scale, leg length, and equipment identity must remain fixed. Each sprite fits inside its cell, feet on the SAME baseline at 450px within each cell, body centered at x=240 within each cell, spare space above/right for weapon. No cropped limbs or weapons. Six genuinely different successive poses, not translated duplicates: top-left relaxed combat idle weapon low; top-middle breathing ready idle; top-right deliberate aimed weapon-raised pose; bottom-left FIRING pose with tiny muzzle flash; bottom-middle clearly visible recoil/bracing pose with hair/coat follow-through; bottom-right lowering/recovery transitioning toward idle. Arms, upper torso and weapon must articulate between poses. Keep modest fully covered sci-fi battle armor. Strong clean outlines, detailed yet readable at 80px high. Effects remain small so anatomy and weapon silhouette are clear.
Character and movement specifics: RION, 22: coral-red short hair, expressive amber eyes, cropped red/white/navy armored jacket, dark bodysuit. Compact cyan crystal plasma carbine held with both hands. Fire/recoil with raised elbows and shoulders rocking back; recover arms lower.
